explanation: The actual values drop significantly to a new, lower level starting around 2024-05, while the forecast remains at the previous higher level. This is a clear structural break that the model has not yet adapted to, likely due to the unrepresented structural break in training data or the model's inability to to predict beyond the target range seen in training. Evidence: actuals drop from ~110-120 range to ~40-80 range; sign_run is high (errors are consistently negative/under-prediction is not the case here, actual is lower than predicted, so residual is negative, error is persistent); the forecast stays at the high level while actuals drop.
